pin_title: 6 Big Halloween Porch & Garden Decorations UK Homes Love
pin_title_alt: 3 Showstopping Halloween Yard Decorations for Trick-or-Treaters
pin_hook: Go big this Halloween - statement pieces that stop the street
pin_description: #ad Big, bold Halloween decorations for your UK porch and garden this year: inflatable black cat, giant spiders, inflatable ghost, hanging grim reapers and more. Statement Halloween yard decor that trick-or-treaters will remember. #halloweendecor #halloweenuk #gardendecor #spookyseason
intro: If your street does Halloween properly, these are the big, eye-catching buys that make a front garden or porch unmissable for trick-or-treaters.

products.name: Danxilu 8FT Inflatable Black Cat & Pumpkins Outdoor Decoration
products.headline: An 8ft showstopper for the front garden
products.why: Self-inflates in seconds and lights up at night, so it's an easy way to make your house the Halloween house on the street.

products.name: JOYIN 4 Pack Halloween Giant Spiders
products.headline: Instantly spooky on a porch or in a tree
products.why: Four large, realistic spiders in different sizes that drape over bushes, doorways or spider webs for an easy spooky effect.

products.name: Joiedomi 12 Ft Tall Halloween Inflatable Ghost
products.headline: A towering ghost with built-in LEDs
products.why: Packs away flat and self-inflates with a built-in fan and lights, giving a big visual impact for not much storage space.

products.name: JOYIN 3 Pack Hanging Grim Reaper Skeletons
products.headline: Eerie hanging figures for trees or porches
products.why: Three 35-inch hanging skeleton ghosts that sway in the breeze - a cheap way to fill a bare tree or porch corner with scares.

products.name: JOYIN 3 Pcs Large Spider Web Candy Baskets
products.headline: Trick-or-treat bowls that double as decor
products.why: Spooky webbed bowls that look great on a hall table and are the right size for handing out sweets on the night.
products.photo_query: spider web candy bowl halloween trick or treat

products.name: Nemesis Now Bewitching Black Cat Figure
products.headline: A witchy little statement piece for a shelf
products.why: A well-made collectable black cat figure that adds a touch of gothic charm to a mantel or windowsill all season.
